bodyweight_push.name: Push-Up (Wall)
instructions: Stand arm-length from the wall, hands at chest height.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lower chest to the wall, press away.

bodyweight_push.name: Push-Up (Incline)
instructions: Hands on a bench, counter, or step.
Lower chest to the surface, press.

bodyweight_push.name: Push-Up (Knee)
instructions: Knees on the floor, hands under shoulders.
Lower chest to the floor, press.

bodyweight_push.name: Push-Up (Flat)
instructions: Hands under shoulders, feet together or apart.
Body one rigid line, glutes squeezed.
Chest to floor, elbows ~45 degrees, press.

bodyweight_push.name: Push-Up (Decline)
instructions: Feet on a bench or step, hands on floor.
Head and chest lowered between hands.
Press up in a straight line.

bodyweight_push.name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Hands together under the sternum, thumbs and index form a diamond.
Elbows brush the ribs on the way down.

bodyweight_push.name: Archer Push-Up
instructions: Wide hands, one arm bent, the other straight.
Shift weight onto the bent arm, lower.

bodyweight_push.name: One-Arm Push-Up (Assisted)
instructions: One hand under chest, other hand on a low step for support.

bodyweight_push.name: One-Arm Push-Up
instructions: Working hand under chest, feet wide.
Lower chest to the floor, elbow tucked.

bodyweight_push.name: One-Arm Decline Push-Up
instructions: Feet on a bench, one hand on the floor.

bodyweight_push.name: Pinky Push-Up
instructions: Standard push-up but on fingertips only.
Stop if any finger joint hurts.

bodyweight_overhead.name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Press back up, head grazing the floor.

bodyweight_overhead.name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
instructions: Feet on a bench, hips stacked high.
Head lowers to the floor between hands.

bodyweight_overhead.name: Wall Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Lower head to the floor under control.

bodyweight_overhead.name: Free Handstand Hold
instructions: Balance on hands without wall support.

bodyweight_overhead.name: Free Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Lower head toward floor, press up.
Keep the line honest — no piking.

bodyweight_overhead.name: Deficit Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Hands on parallettes or books, head lowers below hands.

bodyweight_row.name: Towel Door Row
instructions: Loop a towel around a sturdy door handle.
Lean back, feet close, body straight.
Pull chest to the door, control the descent.

bodyweight_row.name: Table Row (High)
instructions: Grip the edge of a sturdy table.
Body straight, heels on the floor.

bodyweight_row.name: Table Row (Low)
instructions: Grip a low, sturdy table edge.
Pull chest to the edge, squeeze blades.

bodyweight_row.name: Feet-Elevated Table Row
instructions: Feet on a chair, hands under the table.
Pull chest to the edge, lower under control.

bodyweight_row.name: Archer Table Row
instructions: Wide grip on the table edge.
Pull with one arm while the other stays straight.

bodyweight_row.name: One-Arm Assisted Table Row
instructions: One hand grips, the other assists on the edge.
Pull your sternum to the table.

bodyweight_row.name: One-Arm Table Row
instructions: Single-arm row from a low table.
Pull chest to the edge, lower under control.

bodyweight_pull.name: Dead Hang
instructions: Hang from a bar or doorframe pull-up bar.

bodyweight_pull.name: Scapular Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar, arms straight.
Pull the shoulder blades down without bending elbows.
Body rises a few inches, then lowers.

bodyweight_pull.name: Jumping Pull-Up (Eccentric)
instructions: Jump up to the bar, chest over.

bodyweight_pull.name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Loop a band under one knee and over the bar.

bodyweight_pull.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Pull chest to the bar, elbows down and back.

bodyweight_pull.name: L-Sit Pull-Up
instructions: Hold an L-sit leg position throughout.
Pull chest to bar without breaking the shape.

bodyweight_pull.name: Archer Pull-Up
instructions: Wide grip, one arm bent, one arm straight.
Pull with one side while the other stays extended.

bodyweight_pull.name: One-Arm Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Grip bar with one hand, other hand around wrist.

bodyweight_pull.name: One-Arm Pull-Up
instructions: Pull chin over bar without swinging.

bodyweight_squat.name: Chair Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a chair.
Sit down under control, tap lightly.

bodyweight_squat.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Sit back and down to parallel or below.
Drive through the whole foot to stand.

bodyweight_squat.name: Deep Squat Hold
instructions: Squat as deep as possible, chest tall.
Elbows inside knees, gently pressing out.

bodyweight_squat.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot on a bench or chair.
Lower straight down, front knee stacked.
Drive up through the front heel.

bodyweight_squat.name: Assisted Pistol Squat
instructions: Hold a doorframe or TRX strap.
Squat on one leg, free leg extended forward.

bodyweight_squat.name: Pistol Squat
instructions: One leg extended forward, one leg squatting.
Sit fully to the bottom, chest tall.

bodyweight_squat.name: Dragon Pistol
instructions: Rear leg tucked behind, knee down first.
Sit fully with the back knee lowering.
Drive up on the front leg.

bodyweight_squat.name: Shrimp Squat
instructions: Rear foot held by same-side hand.
Lower back knee to floor in front of the hips.

bodyweight_hinge.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat.
Drive hips up until body is one line.
Squeeze glutes hard at the top.

bodyweight_hinge.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Same as bridge, one foot planted.

bodyweight_hinge.name: Elevated Single-Leg Bridge
instructions: One foot on a chair, other leg extended.
Drive hips up in a line.

bodyweight_hinge.name: Single-Leg RDL
instructions: Hinge forward on one leg, back leg long.

bodyweight_hinge.name: Nordic Curl (Eccentric Only)
instructions: Kneel, ankles anchored by a partner or heavy furniture.
Lower the torso forward as slowly as possible.
Catch with hands, push back to knees.

bodyweight_hinge.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Lower yourself forward and pull yourself back with hamstrings.
Full range, no help from hands if possible.

bodyweight_hinge.name: Glute-Ham Raise (Floor)
instructions: Kneel on a pad, heels wedged under a loaded bar or couch.
Keep hips extended the whole way.
Fall forward, pull back with hamstrings.

bodyweight_hinge.name: Single-Leg RDL Deficit
instructions: Stand on a low step or book.
Hinge forward, free leg long behind.
Touch the floor if flexibility allows.

bodyweight_core.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on back, arms and legs up.
Lower opposite arm and leg toward floor.

bodyweight_core.name: Plank Hold
instructions: Body one straight line, glutes tight.
Breathe slowly behind a firm brace.

bodyweight_core.name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: On back, shoulders and legs hovering.
Lower back glued to the floor.

bodyweight_core.name: Hollow Rock
instructions: Rock shoulders and hips together on the back.

bodyweight_core.name: RKC Plank
instructions: Elbows pulled toward toes, glutes max squeezed.

bodyweight_core.name: Body Saw (Towel)
instructions: Forearms on a towel, feet on floor.
Rock the whole body backward and forward.

bodyweight_core.name: Towel Ab Walkout
instructions: Forearms on a towel, walk hands forward.
Extend as far as control allows.

bodyweight_core.name: Dragon Flag (Tuck)
instructions: Lie on back, hands gripping a bench behind you.
Lift hips and torso off floor, tuck knees.
Lower under control, keep the shape.

bodyweight_core.name: Dragon Flag (Full)
instructions: Body straight from shoulders to toes, only upper back on the ground.
Stop before the lower back arches.

bodyweight_core.name: L-Sit (Floor)
instructions: Hands on floor, press the whole body up.

bodyweight_core.name: Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on back, feet anchored lightly.

bodyweight_core.name: V-Up
instructions: Sit up and reach hands to toes.

bodyweight_core.name: Leg Raise (Floor)
instructions: Lift legs to vertical, lower with control.

bodyweight_core.name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with active shoulders.
Lift straight legs to horizontal or above.

bodyweight_core.name: Toes to Bar
instructions: Toes tap the bar between hands.

bodyweight_core.name: Side Plank
instructions: Ribs down, breathe behind the brace.

bodyweight_core.name: Side Plank with Hip Dip
instructions: Lower hip toward the floor, lift back up.

bodyweight_core.name: Copenhagen Plank (Knee)
instructions: Knee on a bench, side plank on the elbow.

bodyweight_core.name: Copenhagen Plank (Ankle)
instructions: Ankle on a bench, side plank.

bodyweight_calves.name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Stand tall on the ball of the foot.
Full stretch at bottom, tall tiptoe at top.

bodyweight_calves.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise (Floor)
instructions: One foot flat on the floor.

bodyweight_calves.name: Calf Raise (Step Edge)
instructions: Ball of foot on a step, heel hanging.
Deep stretch at bottom, drive up.

bodyweight_calves.name: Single-Leg Step Calf Raise
instructions: One foot on the step edge.

bodyweight_calves.name: Single-Leg Pogo
instructions: Hop on one leg with stiff ankle.

bodyweight_calves.name: Jump Rope (Basic)
instructions: Wrists turn the rope, not the arms.

bodyweight_cardio.name: High Knees
instructions: Stay on balls of the feet.

bodyweight_cardio.name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Plank position, drive knees to chest.

bodyweight_cardio.name: Burpees
instructions: Squat, hands to floor, kick to plank.
Push-up, jump feet in, jump up.

bodyweight_cardio.name: Bear Crawl (Forward)
instructions: Hands and feet on the floor, knees off.
Crawl forward with opposite hand and foot.

bodyweight_cardio.name: Stair Climbs
instructions: Find a staircase or step-up box.

bodyweight_cardio.name: Zone 2 Run (30 min)
instructions: Easy pace you can speak at.

bodyweight_power.name: Broad Jump
instructions: Jump forward as far as possible.

bodyweight_power.name: Tuck Jump
instructions: Jump up, drive knees to chest.
Land soft in a quarter squat.

bodyweight_power.name: Split Jump
instructions: Jump up, switch legs in air.
Land soft in the opposite split.

bodyweight_power.name: Depth Drop to Stick
instructions: Step off a low box or step.
Land on both feet in a quarter squat.
Stick the landing like a statue.

bodyweight_power.name: Plyo Push-Up (Box Drop)
instructions: Hands on floor, drop from a low box.

bodyweight_power.name: One-Arm Med Ball Slam (Bodyweight Sub)
instructions: Explosive standing side-crunch to one side.

bodyweight_speed.name: A-Skip Drill
instructions: Crisp skip, punch knee to hip height.

bodyweight_speed.name: High-Knee Run in Place
instructions: Knees to hip height, fast cadence.
Stay on balls of the feet.

bodyweight_speed.name: Ankle Dribbles
instructions: Tiny fast steps from the ankles.

bodyweight_speed.name: 20-Yard Fly Sprint
instructions: Jog-in then hit top speed for 20 yards.

bodyweight_agility.name: Line Hop (Front-Back)
instructions: Hop forward and back over a line.

bodyweight_agility.name: Line Hop (Lateral)
instructions: Stay on the balls of the feet.

bodyweight_agility.name: 5-10-5 Shuttle (Shoes as Cones)
instructions: Mark 5 and 10 yards with shoes or tape.

bodyweight_agility.name: T-Drill
instructions: Mark a T shape with 4 shoes.

bodyweight_balance.name: Single-Leg Stand (Eyes Open)
instructions: Stand on one leg, knee soft.

bodyweight_balance.name: Single-Leg Stand (Eyes Closed)
instructions: Close eyes and stand on one leg.
Feel the floor with your foot.

bodyweight_balance.name: Single-Leg Stand on Pillow
instructions: Stand on one leg on a pillow or folded towel.

bodyweight_balance.name: Tree Pose (Yoga)
instructions: Foot on inner thigh or calf, not on the knee.
Hands together at chest or overhead.

bodyweight_balance.name: Single-Leg RDL Balance
instructions: Hinge forward on one leg, back leg long.
Touch floor if possible, stand back up.

bodyweight_balance.name: Star Excursion (Balance Reach)
instructions: Reach free leg to 8 points around a clock.
Light toe taps, return to center.

bodyweight_coordination.name: Cross-Crawl March
instructions: March in place, opposite elbow to opposite knee.

bodyweight_coordination.name: Cross-Crawl Supine
instructions: Lie on back, arms and knees up.
Touch opposite hand to opposite knee.

bodyweight_coordination.name: Skipping (Bodyweight)
instructions: Skip forward, opposite arm to leg.

bodyweight_coordination.name: Bear Crawl (Contralateral)
instructions: Crawl forward with opposite hand and foot.

bodyweight_coordination.name: Crab Walk
instructions: Walk forward on hands and feet.

bodyweight_reaction.name: Wall-Toss Catch
instructions: Throw a small ball at a wall.

bodyweight_reaction.name: Wall-Toss Catch (Alternating)
instructions: Same throw, but alternate catching hands.

bodyweight_reaction.name: Reaction Ball Wall Bounce
instructions: Throw an irregular ball at the wall.

bodyweight_reaction.name: Partner Ball Drop
instructions: Weight on the balls of your feet.

bodyweight_reaction.name: Hand-Slap Reaction
instructions: Partner tries to slap your hands.

bodyweight_reaction.name: Reaction Ball Solo (Wall)
instructions: Same as wall bounce but with reaction ball.

bodyweight_flexibility.name: Seated Forward Fold
instructions: Round only at the very end.

bodyweight_flexibility.name: Lizard Stretch
instructions: Deep lunge, hands inside front foot.

bodyweight_flexibility.name: Couch Stretch
instructions: Rear shin against a wall, knee down.

bodyweight_flexibility.name: Pigeon Pose
instructions: Front shin forward, back leg long.

bodyweight_flexibility.name: Thoracic Open Book
instructions: Open top arm, follow with eyes.

bodyweight_flexibility.name: Downward Dog
instructions: Heels reach down, chest toward thighs.

bodyweight_flexibility.name: Standing Quad Stretch
instructions: Heel to glute, knee points at the floor.
Stand tall, hold a wall if needed.

bodyweight_flexibility.name: Wall Calf Stretch
instructions: Hands on wall, one leg back.
Lean in as one rigid line.
